policies.fit: each month M: approvals strictly before M-60 days and labels strictly before M; train-only preprocessing
policies.historical_scores: each historical month uses its own monthly model; never final-model rescores of training rows
policies.ranking: uncalibrated score descending then order_id ascending; threshold zero, fill daily floor(10% * complete eligible scored batch)
policies.label_maturity: historical validation outcomes strictly before E; unknown labels still compete for full-batch slots
policies.selection: maximize worst recall of three known-label historical months, then pooled TP, pooled raw AP, fixed candidate order
policies.floor: 30% each historical month is a diagnostic suitability gate; no future recall guarantee
policies.search: six predefined candidate/feature combinations and fixed parameters; no evaluation-based early stopping or parameter choice
policies.comparison: legacy_candidates applies same new selector to old four models; old primary shown separately; changing selection and models is not a pure feature effect
policies.features: seller/route history uses deliveries strictly before query approval, 90-day window; seller ID and ZIP3 from static master tables
policies.probabilities: ranking scores uncalibrated; no new calibration fit or reliable probability claim
policies.evaluation_role: previously inspected development months only; earlier evaluation can enter later historical validation
policies.coverage: eligible valid eventually-delivered cohort only; not every originally approved order
policies.batch_timing: complete closed calendar-day batches required; up to one day wait; no per-order online cap guarantee
policies.promotion: new artifacts remain research only; original and prior research models preserved
policies.visualization: no dashboard or new plots in this experiment; user requested ranking work first

split.training_source_cutoff: Training approvals are strictly before model_fit_time minus 60 days; training delivery labels are strictly before model_fit_time. Each fitted model and preprocessing pipeline use only this training partition.
split.scoring_source_cutoff: Scoring cohort uses only approval timestamps within the supplied valid-delivered cohort; it is not filtered by label availability. Prior event features must still use only completed events strictly before each individual approval.
split.maturity_scope: Maturity exclusions are within the existing valid delivered cohort only; cancelled, unfinished and other excluded orders do not receive inferred negative labels.

selected_development_miss_diagnostics.grouping_notes: Small groups retained; minimum_sample_met requires >=30 rows and >=5 delayed orders. All shares use observed FN counts, not causal attribution; null rates have zero denominator.
selected_development_miss_diagnostics.rank_notes: Within each complete closed day: calibrated score descending, raw score descending, order_id ascending; one-based rank / full eligible daily batch; independent of labels.

suitability.note: Historical floor is the selection gate. Development stability is a post-selection observation, not independent validation or a reason to pick a different candidate.
